chapters.title: 01. Welcome, Course Setup & Portal Access
chapters.description: Introduction to Session 1 of the Sixth Form College AI Training Course. Covers presenter welcome, how to access the course portal and shared credentials, and what to expect across upcoming sessions.

chapters.title: 02. Shared Docs, QR Codes & Community Onboarding
chapters.description: Hands-on onboarding into the shared workspace and Skool community. Demonstrates generating QR codes for fast link sharing, joining the classroom, and using open chat for Q&A and troubleshooting.

chapters.title: 03. Live Collaboration & Rapid AI Skills (RACE)
chapters.description: Exploring live cursor-follow collaboration and the RACE framework (Rapid AI Increases Skills Expectations) — why hands-on classroom practice matters as AI capabilities accelerate.

chapters.title: 04. AI Agent Harnesses, Claude Models & Building Agents
chapters.description: Understanding AI agent harnesses (why a model needs tools, arms, and legs to act), how Anthropic's Claude models power real-world agents, and why you should start by running proven agent tools before building your own from scratch.

chapters.title: 05. Bots vs. Agents — Mindset & Multi-Role Workflows
chapters.description: Part 2 kicks off with the core mindset shift between general-purpose bots and focused agents, understanding day-one compute/subscription economics, and orchestrating multiple specialized roles working together simultaneously.

chapters.title: 06. Designing Specialized Bots (SEO, Radar & Content)
chapters.description: Walkthrough of practical bot architectures you can create — including Keyword Topic Radar, AI Answer, Technical SEO Crawl Monitor, and Traffic Drop alerts — and how reusable agents differ from custom company bots.

chapters.title: 07. AI Building AI — Cost Per Goal & Multi-Model Keys
chapters.description: Entering the era of AI building AI: evaluating Cost Per Goal to build viable digital businesses, managing API keys across an omni-model system (including DeepInfra), and balancing model pricing vs. output quality.

chapters.title: 08. Scaling to 300 Agents & Real-World Bot Walkthrough
chapters.description: What happens when you scale up to 300 agents (compute limits, goal prioritization, and task boards) plus a live walkthrough of how structured titles and prompts drive autonomous bot actions.

chapters.title: 09. Digital Equity, Bot Specs & Live Approval Wrap-Up
chapters.description: Closing wrap-up covering digital agents, digital equity, and digital businesses, reviewing bot specifications, and seeing an autonomous bot approve a live classroom access request in real time.
